notes: Comprehensive political biography of Rishang Keishing (1920-2017), distinguished Tangkhul statesman, member of India's first Lok Sabha (1952), longest-serving Chief Minister of Manipur, and revered elder parliamentarian.

front_matter.title_page: Rishang Keishing: The Legendary Tangkhul Parliamentarian and Chief Minister (2018)
front_matter.preface: Rishang Keishing was a titan of Indian democracy and the pride of the Tangkhul Naga community. Born in Bungpa village in 1920, he was elected to India's first Lok Sabha in 1952, working alongside Jawaharlal Nehru. He served as Chief Minister of Manipur across multiple tumultuous decades, championing inter-community harmony, highland development, and democratic constitutionalism.

chapters.title: From Bungpa Village to India's First Lok Sabha (1920-1952)
chapters.summary: Youth in southern Tangkhul village Bungpa, St. Paul's College Calcutta, and election to the 1st Lok Sabha in 1952.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Chapter 1: Rishang Keishing October 25, 1920 zingsho eina Bungpa Khullen village-li pharisaye. Ana Calcutta St. Paul's Cathedral Mission College eina graduate saye. 1952-li Indiawui first General Election shoklakha, a Outer Manipur Parliamentary constituency eina first Lok Sabha-li Member of Parliament (MP) elect saye. A Parliament of India-wui youngest MPs tharili akha leisai.
chapters.english_translation: Rishang Keishing was born on October 25, 1920, in Bungpa Khullen village, Ukhrul district. He graduated from St. Paul's Cathedral Mission College, Calcutta. In India's historic first general election in 1952, he was elected to the first Lok Sabha from Outer Manipur, becoming one of the youngest and most articulate parliamentarians in free India.

chapters.title: Chief Minister of Manipur & Champion of Communal Harmony
chapters.summary: Serving as Chief Minister during difficult decades, balancing hill-valley unity and tribal development.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Chapter 2: Rishang Keishingna multiple terms-wui vang Manipur State-wui Chief Minister salaga ot sai. Ana valley kala hill tribeswui ngachaili peace, secular unity, kala infrastructural development phung-ungmi. Ana high schools, roads, water supply, kala hospitals kaphung-longkhor kuppupli shimsakserie. Ana democratic dialogue eina conflict resolution-li faith khuiye.
chapters.english_translation: Rishang Keishing served multiple tenures as Chief Minister of Manipur. Navigating ethnic conflicts and insurgency, he steadfastly championed harmony between the valley and hill communities. He expanded roads, high schools, electrification, and medical centers across remote hill districts, believing passionately in democratic constitutional dialogue.
grammar_notes: Administrative and developmental syntax in Tangkhul.

chapters.title: Elder Statesman of the Rajya Sabha & Final Years (1920-2017)
chapters.summary: Elder statesman in the Rajya Sabha retiring at age 94, and his enduring legacy of democratic service.
chapters.tangkhul_text: Chapter 3: Rishang Keishingna 2014 thakli Rajya Sabha MP salaga public service-li leisai, a Indiawui oldest sitting parliamentarian hoda retire saye (age 94). August 22, 2017 zingsho eina ana Imphal-li shok-unglakna. Awui 60 years public service Tangkhul people-wui democratic pride thada history-li thot pupup mathā-leisara.
chapters.english_translation: Rishang Keishing continued serving in the Rajya Sabha until 2014, retiring as India's oldest sitting parliamentarian at the age of 94. He passed away on August 22, 2017, in Imphal. His six decades of distinguished public service remain an enduring source of democratic pride for the Tangkhul people and the nation.
